svg.title: Packages of hylo-harness
svg.desc: The packages of hylo-harness by layer. Interface: cli. Evolution: evolve and learn. Evaluation: eval and catalog. Cognition: agents, memory, policies, instruments and reasoners. All build on hylo-core, the kernel: contracts, the episode kernel, the SafetyShield, the plugin registry and the store. Adapters to LeRobot, openpi and LLMs plug into the registry through entry points.
